title: ONE SHOT — winner takes all
best_note: 24 leading zero bits on this template (tier 2 near-miss). A block needs 79.
odds: A full 2^32 sweep has about a 7 in 1,000,000,000,000,000 chance of a block. This is a lottery ticket, not a path. One shot per block, winner takes all. The template rolls to a fresh block every ~10 minutes.
